<!-- 6.FADE_report.Rmd — Gene-level and site-level summary of the FADE results of one direction. -->
<!-- PhyloPhere | subworkflows/FADE/local/ -->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  out.width = "100%"
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(paletteer)
  library(DT)
})

source('report_style.R')
set_report_style()
.tableau10 <- report_palette(10)
metadata <- if (!is.null(params$metadata_file)) jsonlite::fromJSON(params$metadata_file) else NULL
known_settings <- !is.null(metadata)
if (known_settings) {
  stopifnot(isTRUE(metadata$complete), metadata$direction == params$direction)
  trait_label <- metadata$settings$traitname
  bf_thr <- metadata$settings$bf_threshold
} else {
  trait_label <- params$traitname
  bf_thr <- NA_real_
}
cutoff_text <- if (known_settings) paste0('BF ≥ ', bf_thr) else 'the original cutoff (not recorded)'

```

---

## Overview

This report summarises the results of **FADE** (FUBAR Approach to Directional
Evolution) applied to **`r params$direction`**
foreground branches associated with the phenotype **`r trait_label`**.

FADE quantifies, for each site in each protein alignment, whether the
**foreground branches** show a statistically elevated substitution bias towards
a particular amino acid, relative to the background rate modelled on the full
tree.  Evidence is measured by the **Bayes Factor (BF)** for each site × target
amino-acid combination.  Hits in these tables met **`r cutoff_text`**. Gene maxima describe site evidence; they are not calibrated gene-level significance tests.

---

## Analysis Setup

```{r analysis-setup-fade, echo=FALSE}
has_fg <- !is.null(params$fg_list_file) &&
          nchar(params$fg_list_file) > 0 &&
          file.exists(params$fg_list_file)

if (has_fg) {
  fg_sp <- readLines(params$fg_list_file)
  fg_sp <- fg_sp[nzchar(trimws(fg_sp)) & !grepl("^#", fg_sp)]
  cat(sprintf("**Foreground species (%s direction): %d species**\n\n",
              params$direction, length(fg_sp)))
  knitr::kable(
    data.frame(Foreground_species = fg_sp),
    caption = "Foreground species pool; per-gene retention is audited"
  )
} else {
  cat("> Foreground species list not provided to this report.\n\n")
  cat("> Species are specified via `--branches` flags in the HyPhy command.\n")
}
```

---

```{r load-tables}
# ── Merged FADE tables of this direction (written by FADE_TABLES) ───────────────
# gene_counts_file: one row per gene (n_sites_tested, n_sig_site_aa, max_bf, top_target_aa, top_site and the sigcount_<AA> columns),
# by decreasing n_sig_site_aa and max_bf. sites_file: one row per significant site (gene, position 0-based, max_bf, target_aa).

gene_summary <- read.delim(params$gene_counts_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                           colClasses = c(gene='character'), na.strings=character())
sig_sites <- read.csv(params$sites_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses=c(gene='character'), na.strings=character()) %>%
  mutate(site = position + 1L) %>%          # 1-based FADE site index
  select(gene, site, position, max_bf, target_aa)

if (known_settings) {
  stopifnot(nrow(gene_summary) == metadata$tested)
  check_hash <- function(path, expected) {
    stopifnot(identical(digest::digest(file=path, algo='sha256'), expected))
  }
  check_hash(params$gene_counts_file, metadata$output_sha256[[paste0('fade_gene_counts_',params$direction,'.tsv')]])
  check_hash(params$sites_file, metadata$output_sha256[[paste0('fade_sites_',params$direction,'.csv')]])
  if (has_fg && !is.null(metadata$foreground_sha256)) check_hash(params$fg_list_file, metadata$foreground_sha256)
}
if (known_settings) {
  cat(sprintf('Coverage: %d expected gene/direction runs; %d tested; %d biological exclusions.\n',
              metadata$expected, metadata$tested, metadata$excluded))
} else {
  cat('Original settings and completion audit were not recorded. These legacy tables do not establish full run coverage.\n')
}
if (nrow(gene_summary) == 0) {
  message("No FADE results for the ", params$direction, " direction ",
          "(no eligible genes or an empty input universe).")
}

cat(sprintf(
  "✓ Read %d genes | %d significant (gene, site) rows.\n",
  nrow(gene_summary), nrow(sig_sites)
))
```

## Gene-level Summary

```{r gene-summary}
# Genes with at least one site x AA pair at or above bf_thr (gene_summary has one row per gene).
sig_genes <- gene_summary %>% filter(n_sig_site_aa > 0)

cat(sprintf(
  "✓ Gene-level summary created: %d genes tested, %d with ≥1 site meeting %s\n",
  nrow(gene_summary), nrow(sig_genes), cutoff_text
))
```

```{r gene-table}
DT::datatable(
  gene_summary %>%
    select(gene, n_sites_tested, n_sig_site_aa, max_bf, top_target_aa, top_site) %>%
    mutate(max_bf = ifelse(is.infinite(max_bf), 'Inf', as.character(round(max_bf, 2)))) %>%
    rename(
      Gene              = gene,
      `Sites tested`    = n_sites_tested,
      `Sig. site×AA`   = n_sig_site_aa,
      `Max BF`          = max_bf,
      `Top target AA`   = top_target_aa,
      `Top site pos.`   = top_site
    ),
  filter    = "top",
  rownames  = FALSE,
  options   = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE),
  caption   = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
    sprintf("Gene-level FADE summary | %s | Direction: %s",
            cutoff_text, toupper(params$direction))
  )
)
```

---

## Significant Sites (all)

```{r sig-sites-table}
if (nrow(sig_sites) == 0) {
  cat(sprintf("No sites met %s in the %s direction.\n",
              cutoff_text, toupper(params$direction)))
} else {
  DT::datatable(
    sig_sites %>%
      transmute(
        Gene            = gene,
        `Site (1-based)` = site,
        `Position (0-based)` = position,
        `Max BF`        = ifelse(is.infinite(max_bf), 'Inf', as.character(round(max_bf, 2))),
        `Target AA`     = target_aa
      ),
    filter   = "top",
    rownames = FALSE,
    options  = list(pageLength = 25, scrollX = TRUE),
    caption  = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = "caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-weight: bold;",
      sprintf("All significant FADE sites | %s | Direction: %s | %d sites across %d genes",
              cutoff_text, toupper(params$direction),
              nrow(sig_sites), length(unique(sig_sites$gene)))
    )
  )
}
```

## Visualisations

### Distribution of maximum Bayes Factors across genes

```{r bf-distribution, fig.height=5}
finite_genes <- gene_summary %>% filter(is.finite(max_bf), max_bf > 0)
cat(sprintf('%d infinite and %d zero gene maxima are retained in the table and omitted from the log histogram.\n',
            sum(is.infinite(gene_summary$max_bf)), sum(gene_summary$max_bf == 0)))
if (nrow(finite_genes) > 0) {
ggplot(finite_genes, aes(x = max_bf)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = .tableau10[1], colour = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  {if (known_settings) geom_vline(xintercept = bf_thr, colour = .tableau10[2], linetype = 'dashed', linewidth = 0.8)} +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title    = paste("Max Bayes Factor per gene —", toupper(params$direction), "direction"),
    subtitle = trait_label,
    x        = "Max Bayes Factor (log10 scale)",
    y        = "Number of genes"
  ) +
  report_theme(base_size = 13)
} else cat('No finite, positive maxima to display.\n')
```

### Target amino-acid frequency among significant site × AA hits

```{r aa-frequency, fig.height=5}
if (nrow(sig_genes) == 0) {
  cat("No significant genes to plot.\n")
} else {
  # Per-AA counts of significant site x AA pairs come from the sigcount_<AA> columns,
  # summed over genes.
  aa_freq <- gene_summary %>%
    select(starts_with("sigcount_")) %>%
    summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "target_aa", names_prefix = "sigcount_", values_to = "n") %>%
    filter(n > 0) %>%
    arrange(desc(n))

  ggplot(aa_freq, aes(x = reorder(target_aa, n), y = n)) +
    geom_col(fill = .tableau10[5], alpha = 0.85) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Target amino-acid frequency in significant hits —",
                    toupper(params$direction)),
      x = "Target amino acid",
      y = "Number of significant site × AA combinations"
    ) +
    report_theme(base_size = 16)
}
```


---

## Methods

**Tool:** FADE (FUBAR Approach to Directional Evolution) via HyPhy ≥ 2.5.

**Branch labelling:** The foreground comes from the global pre-Dunn candidate pool (or the supplied species file), direction **`r params$direction`**. Per-gene taxa are reconciled without changing alignment columns. A rooted reference tree is required.

```{r recorded-methods, results='asis'}
if (known_settings) {
  st <- metadata$settings
  cat(sprintf('**Background scope:** `%s`. In `all`, all other retained branches provide background; in `opposite`, only foreground plus opposite-pool taxa are retained.\n\n', st$background_scope))
  cat(sprintf('**Internal foreground branches:** `%s`. `all_descendants` includes the stem of each all-foreground clade; `none` labels terminal branches only.\n\n', st$internal_nodes))
  cat(sprintf('**Substitution model:** `%s`; **inference method:** `%s`; **grid:** %d; **Dirichlet concentration:** %g.\n\n', st$model, st$method, st$grid, st$concentration))
  cat(sprintf('**Original evidence cutoff:** BF ≥ %g.\n\n', st$bf_threshold))
} else {
  cat('Model, branch settings and original cutoff are unknown for these legacy inputs.\n')
}
```

FADE evidence is evaluated per site and target amino acid. A gene with a hit has at least one such combination meeting the cutoff. The maximum across sites is descriptive and does not correct for gene length or multiple comparisons. See the [HyPhy method documentation](https://www.hyphy.org/methods/selection-methods/#fade).

---

## Summary

This report summarizes the results of the **FADE** analysis.
